articles.title: ‘You don’t let us near F35 aircraft and you are talking about selling jet to us', says IAF chief jokingly while sitting beside US commander'
articles.summary: Indian Air Force chief Air Chief Marshal A P Singh expressed strong criticism regarding potential defence procurements. He highlighted the frustration that Indian personnel were denied access to inspect aircraft, despite ongoing discussions about a sale. This incident underscores the critical need for transparency and full access during the evaluation phase of military acquisitions to ensure India's strategic interests and due diligence in defence deals.

articles.title: LOC over marriage dispute: HC seeks Haryana response to US green card holder’s plea
articles.summary: Punjab CM Mann accused the BJP of misusing central agencies against him for defending Punjab's rights. Separately, Aam Aadmi Party leaders, including Manish Sisodia, were detained during a protest against the Chief Election Commissioner. These events underscore current political tensions and protests concerning federal relations and electoral bodies within India.
